description: This file implements a notification backend for handling @mentions in a collaborative application, managing listeners, processing block change events, and delivering mention notifications with permission checks.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Implements the notification backend for @mentions, managing listeners, event handling, and notification delivery.

classes.name: BackendParams
classes.description: Holds dependencies and configuration for initializing the Backend.

classes.name: MentionListener
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified when a mention occurs.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Backend instance with provided parameters.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the backend; currently a no-op.

methods.name: ShutDown
methods.description: Flushes logs and shuts down the backend.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the backend.

methods.name: AddListener
methods.description: Adds a MentionListener to the backend.

methods.name: RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a MentionListener from the backend.

methods.name: BlockChanged
methods.description: Handles block change events, detects mentions, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: deliverMentionNotification
methods.description: Performs permission checks and delivers a mention notification to the user.
